newsitem.title: USA: Rexene holders mail proxy, seek new board.
newsitem.headline: Rexene holders mail proxy, seek new board.

text.p: Wyser-Pratte & Co Inc and Spear, Leeds & Kellogg said on Thursday they have mailed a letter and preliminary solicitation statement to shareholders of Rexene Corp asking the holders to support their efforts to replace Rexene's current board of directors and amend the company's by-laws.
Wyser-Pratte and Spear, Leeds & Kellogg said they own a combined 1.9 million shares or about 10.1 percent of Rexene's outstanding common stock.

In an earlier staement, Wyser-Pratte and Spear, Leeds & Kellogg said they nominated a slate that included Jonathan Macey, Robert Mauch, Lawrence McQuade and James Pasman Jr. to Rexene's board. They said these proposed directors would be committed to considering the previously proposed offer from Huntsman Corp as well as any higher offers made for Rexene by qualified purchasers.
Rexene rejected in early November a $16 per share takeover bid from Huntsman.
